summary: Tested Produzione: work order PDF (scheda di lavoro), per-phase actual time registrations and the standard vs actual cost comparison (consuntivo), on both backend and UI. New pytest suite: 8/8 passed. Regression suite iteration79: 12/12 passed. UI flow on /produzione all worked: print button, timer dialog, add and delete times, live comparison table, comparison in the expanded row, refresh after closing the dialog.

minor.issue: Times can still be added to or deleted from orders with status 'chiuso' (completed/closed); only 'pianificato' is blocked. This may be intended for late registrations; please confirm.
An unknown tid returns 200 and silently does nothing (no 404).
'Da prelevare' column = per-piece qty * full order qty, ignoring what was already produced or picked (partial versamenti). Acceptable, but could show the remaining quantity.

issues: Date input uses the browser's native date picker (type=date) instead of a shadcn calendar
Minutes shown with dot decimals (e.g. '45.5 min effettivi su 90 previsti') in an Italian UI; use a comma like the rest of the app
today() uses toISOString (UTC): just after midnight Italian time the default date is yesterday; in UTC-negative timezones it could be tomorrow and the server rejects it as a future date

action_items: Optional: decide whether time registrations should be blocked on 'chiuso' orders
Optional: format minutes with Italian decimals in TempiFasi and use a local date for the default date
critical_code_review_comments: consuntivo(): eff_materiali falls back to std_materiali when there are no versamenti, so the variance before any production only reflects labour. This is reasonable, but the UI does not show it.
The tempo_add/tempo_del lock is per company and in-memory (single process only). Fine for the current deployment.
PDF escapes user text correctly: 'Taglio <&> lamiera' and a note containing '<b>' rendered without breaking reportlab.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_T80 companies/user/session via fixture; all cleaned up afterwards (only TEST_T80 company ids).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_iteration80_tempi_pdf.py tests/test_iteration79_produzione.py -n 0.
